profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Angular, .NET, & React
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Mikal Young, and I am a Full-Stack Developer and UCF Computer Science graduate  dedicated to creating technology that makes a positive impact. Currently, at Gogo Business Aviation , I architect Single-Page Applications using Angular and ASP.NET  to bridge the gap between complex data and intuitive user interfaces. My work focuses on building robust systems for payment processing , data management, and federal regulatory compliance.

    My technical expertise is centered on C#, SQL, and TypeScript , along with modern UI frameworks like React and Vue. In my free time, I find joy in exploring new technologies and building personal projects that solve everyday problems and provide value to others.

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer II
positions.description:
• Reduced feature delivery time by over 50% on critical billing applications by embedding AI/LLM workflows into the Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), improving documentation quality and team throughput

• Ensured near 100% billing accuracy across tens of thousands of monthly invoices by extending a high-throughput billing engine with complex customer plan configurations to process millions of data records

• Reclaimed 8 developer story points per sprint by architecting an Angular and RESTful .NET API Single-Page Application (SPA) that simplified the visualization and management of complex, hierarchical product pricing data

• Achieved SOX compliance for financial auditing workflows by engineering a full-stack system that dynamically captures, compares, and logs real-time modifications to sensitive records

• Sustained application stability across Dev, Test, and Prod environments by managing routine deployments, updating secure configuration tokens, and utilizing Azure Application Insights to triage and resolve real-time outage alerts
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Angular · SQL · JavaScript · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Improved customer service workflows by developing modular Angular Directives that dynamically toggle form validity based on UI visibility, preventing validation bottlenecks for agents
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · .NET Framework · Software Development · C# · Front-End Development · Angular

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Modernized the web platform of a major entertainment streaming service by upgrading it to the Vue.js framework, ensuring cross-platform compatibility and improving user accessibility

• Secured premium video content for thousands of daily users by implementing DRM protection and JWT authentication, while utilizing Nuxt.js for Server-Side Rendering (SSR) to optimize initial page load times and web responsiveness

• Developed responsive, Server-Side Rendered web pages based on Figma designs using Nuxt.js, a framework built on Node.js and Vue.js
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · JavaScript · Software Development · Redux.js · Front-End Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Minimized infrastructure overhead by building a serverless backend using AWS Lambda, eliminating the need for dedicated server maintenance while also integrating third-party APIs into ZoHo CRM

• Increased sales team engagement and data visibility by deploying a gamification dashboard using Cloud Functions and webhooks to visualize real-time performance metrics

• Automated monthly commission calculations with a Node.js application that parses PDFs, restructures the disarranged data, and generates Excel reports, saving office administrators at least 16 hours a month
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Software Development · AWS Lambda · Node.js · Cloud Computing
